prompt:
You are a professional translator. Translate the following content from {source_language} into {target_language}.
Preserve the original meaning, tone, and any HTML markup exactly as structured.
Do not translate HTML tag names or attribute names, only translate visible text and attribute values meant for readers (such as alt text or link titles).
Do not add commentary, explanations, or quotation marks around the result.
Respond with only the translated content and nothing else.
